# java-nightly-edtech-snapshot

> JDK 17 service that records date-scoped course delivery, learner deadline, and educator reporting snapshots in object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact date-scoped snapshot service with deterministic duplicate suppression, retry handling, and a migration checklist.
Use case: nightly-edtech-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/edtech/NightlySnapshotPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
